timing: After primary beam-information summaries, before validation and sensitivity values. Exploratory numerical and boundary validation, not blinded hypothesis selection.
sample: 12 hosts selected by SHA256 of SN identifier, first ascending hashes; all three bands.
checks: Independent full-catalogue angular neighbour reconstruction without KD tree
Independent GELSY sky removal, GESVD and non-pivoted QR residual
Continuous Gaussian integral and resolution formula
sensitivities: Relative SVD threshold 1e-8 and 1e-12 around primary 1e-10
Neighbour radii 1.5 and 3 nominal FWHM around primary 2
Fit radii 3 and 5 nominal FWHM around primary 4
shared_input: Empirical radial beam profile, truncated at four nominal FWHM, remains fixed; sensitivity does not certify complete beam tails or exact coadd PSF.
interpretation: Model-boundary ratios, no measured host infrared amplitudes.

amendment.timing: After first numerical validation completed and independent review found potential map-pixel sensitivity; before this added sensitivity sweep.
added: Empirical beam radial support 3 and 5 FWHM
3x3 subpixel top-hat averaging at actual map pixel scale
amendment.interpretation: Neither top-hat averaging nor smoothing is calibrated mapmaking PSF recovery. These quantify sensitivity of all-candidate noise inflation to assumptions. Added outcomes are exploratory, not preregistered.

numerical_reporting_correction.finding: Expanded neighbour lists or smaller image patches can span the host template. Inverting a residual at floating-point precision produced meaningless finite ~1e14 inflations.
numerical_reporting_correction.action: Use the same original primary residual-norm threshold 1e-10 in sensitivities; report null ratio and explicit numerically-unresolved counts, not finite uncertainty. No physical acceptance tolerance changed.
